Can a dental implant affect the sinus cavity?

Many patients considering dental implants in their upper jaw express concerns about potential complications involving their sinus cavity. This worry often stems from understanding that the upper back teeth sit remarkably close to the maxillary sinuses, leading to questions about whether dental implant placement [could cause sinus problems](https://www.dental-implants-london.co.uk/blog/will-dental-implants-affect-my-sinuses-long-term).

How long can you wait to get a dental implant after losing a tooth?

Losing a tooth can be distressing, whether through injury, extraction, or dental disease. Many patients find themselves wondering about the [timing for dental implant treatment](https://www.dental-implants-london.co.uk/blog/replace-missing-teeth-sooner-or-wait) and whether there's a deadline for replacement. This uncertainty often leads people to search for guidance on implant timing, particularly when balancing healing time with concerns about jawbone changes.

Why does my dental implant hurt or feel loose years later?

If you've had dental implants for several years and are now experiencing discomfort or mobility, you're not alone in this concern. Many patients contact dental practices worried about changes in their previously stable implants, wondering whether pain or looseness indicates a serious problem.

Why is bone height important for upper jaw dental implants?

When considering dental implants for missing upper teeth, many patients discover that bone height plays a crucial role in treatment planning. This anatomical factor often comes as a surprise to those researching implant options, particularly when they learn that additional procedures might be necessary before implant placement can proceed.

What factors influence when a dental implant can be restored?

If you're considering dental implants or have recently had one placed, you're likely wondering when you can have your permanent crown or bridge fitted. This is one of the most common questions patients ask after implant surgery, as the waiting period can feel uncertain. Understanding the factors that influence dental implant restoration timing helps set realistic expectations and supports the best possible outcome for your treatment.
